entries.title: Long conversations use less of your plan allowance
entries.body: The first mate and every crewmate now summarize a long conversation at 300,000 tokens, or sooner on a model that charges more past a certain length, such as GPT-6.1 Sol or Grok. Before, crewmates on Kimi, Copilot, Amazon Bedrock, OpenRouter and custom models could run to about a million tokens, and the first mate kept going past those price steps. Conversations through your Claude sign-in are unchanged.
entries.noPicture: This changes when a conversation summarizes, not how any view looks.
